description: Watch state for Lawrence Noble 1990 Killian Industries (also spelled 'Killian/Kilian Enterprises' in some sources) bronze Yoda statue (limited edition of 50, ~8-11in, made for Empire Strikes Back 10th anniversary). Excludes the unrelated 31-inch life-size Yoda statue (6 artist proofs + 30-piece run, sold via Heritage/Propstore/Sideshow).
